helpmed0g: Valentin Helpmed joined the replacements on Day 4. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
leo.glc: Isidor Glc told the sergeant he was a postman. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed more rain, and put him on sentry.
Volunteer number 61. The quartermaster pinned the First Wave ribbon on Isidor Glc's tunic and said: 'Don't let the mud have it.'
Isidor Glc fired at a movement across the wire at S-F13. The man went down: Florian "Shadow" Slightlyreta, grazed.
Rafael "Button" Superfeisty and Isidor Glc made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it with frozen hands.
Isidor Glc carried three men out of S-F13 on a stretcher. One of them thanked him. Two could not. Victory at Verdel Ridge. Isidor Glc let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Isidor Glc and Quentin Adams tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco.
olie300: Arno Olie introduced himself as a bookbinder from Ashford Vale. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
Edmund Callmequeeno and Arno Olie sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At relief, the next watch was told it had been a good hour.

Arno Olie heard a man laugh beyond the enemy parapet. The sound was ordinary enough to be more unsettling than a shot. Word came down the line: Verdel Ridge is ours. Arno Olie shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Arno Olie found water collecting beneath the gun's cover. He sketched a small shelter and took the drawing to the stores.
